steps.title: Blockbench Bracket Contest
steps.content:
Blockbench Bracket Contest

In this quiz you will submit two possible modelling topics, vote on the full topic list, then build Blockbench models in tournament brackets.

How it works

  1. Everyone submits up to two modelling topics.
  2. Everyone upvotes and downvotes topics.
  3. The highest ranked topics are used for the bracket rounds.
  4. You build a model for your bracket topic in Blockbench.
  5. Students vote on brackets they are not part of.
  6. Winners move forward until there is a champion.

You can submit any Blockbench model for the round topic. There is no cube-count requirement in this contest format.

quizQuestions.sampleAnswer: A submitted Blockbench model for the bracket topic.
